book.name: SAN MATEO
book.title: TZOTIꞌ CꞌUL YET COLBANILE TZꞌIBN̈EBILCANO YU NAJ SAN MATEO

content: Yet yalni naj Juan anican̈ haꞌ iswiꞌ anma Istzotiꞌ Comam Dios
Yet huneꞌ tiempohal tuꞌ xin apni naj Juan anican̈ haꞌ iswiꞌ anma bey txꞌotxꞌ desierto, yul ismajul Judea.
Yalni naj tet anma apni bey tuꞌ: —Bejwecano hewatxꞌen istxꞌojal, yuto yocxa Comam Dios ay yul satcan̈ yahawo teyin̈, ẍi naj.
Haꞌ ton yin̈ naj Juan tiꞌ bay yal naj Isaías, huneꞌ ischejab Comam Dios yet payat, yet istzꞌibn̈encano naj hacaꞌ tiꞌ:

content.text: Ay huneꞌ naj chiawi yin̈ caw ip bey huneꞌ txꞌotxꞌ desierto, chalni naj: “Watxꞌeweco heyanma yuto chihul Comam Dios Jahawil. Hacaꞌ chu istoholban̈elax hunu beh yet chihul hunu naj jahaw, hac tuꞌ cheyute hayanma,” ẍi naj, ẍi yul Yum Comam Dios.

content: Wal naj Juan tuꞌ, xil noꞌ camello watxꞌebilayo xilo iskꞌap naj, tzꞌum noꞌ xin ayco istxꞌambalo naj. Haꞌ tzet chislo naj haꞌ ton noꞌ niẍte nokꞌ hacaꞌ noꞌ litꞌ yeb noꞌ cab ay xolaj telaj.
Hantan̈e xin anma yul con̈ob Jerusalén yeb yul ismajul Judea, yebpaxo anma ayayo istila haꞌ niman Jordán apni abeno tzet yal naj.
Yet chalnati anma ismul xin, cat yahcano haꞌ iswiꞌ yu naj Juan yul haꞌ niman Jordán.
Hayet yilni naj Juan tato txꞌiꞌal ebnaj fariseo

yeb ebnaj saduceo apni iscꞌatan̈ yu yah haꞌ iswiꞌ, yalni naj tet ebnaj: —Hex tiꞌ caw hacaꞌtan̈e heyicꞌal heba yeb noꞌ laba, caw helanex hecolni heba. ¿Mac halni teyet ta yun̈e chꞌah haꞌ hewiꞌ yuxin chexcolcha tet huneꞌ isyaꞌtajil chati Comam Dios?
Tato caw yeli xaheyacano sunilal istxꞌojal, yilal heyenilo yu iscꞌulal chewatxꞌe.

Tajca chetxum hacaꞌ tiꞌ: “Han̈on̈tiꞌan̈ jichmaman̈ ye icham Abraham, yuxin xacon̈colchahan̈ yalan̈ isyaꞌtajil chatiꞌ Comam Dios, tajca quexchi. Wal xin chiwalan teyet, tato choche Comam Dios chu yanico Comam huntekꞌan chꞌen chꞌen tiꞌ yuninalo icham Abraham heseleloj.

Cawilxa yeti huneꞌ isyaꞌtajil chati Comam Dios, lahan hacaꞌ yet yocxa chꞌen eche yich xeꞌ hunu te teꞌ yu istzꞌocꞌlaxayo teꞌ. Yuxin sunil te teꞌ mach cꞌulo issatni chitzocꞌlaxayo teꞌ cat iskꞌojlaxto teꞌ yul kꞌaꞌ.

Yin̈ caw yeli hanintiꞌan han̈e ha haꞌ chiwakꞌan yahbalo haꞌ hewiꞌ yun̈e isyenicanilo isba tato caw yeli xahebejcano istxꞌojal. Yaj ay huneꞌ naj tzujan yul wintajan, naj tuꞌ chiyacan̈ naj haꞌ hewiꞌ, yaj yu iskꞌakꞌal yip Comam Espíritu Santo. Haꞌ naj tuꞌ caw ecꞌbalcano yelapno ye naj insatajan, walinan xin caw matzet welapnojan chiwabehan, nitam intꞌun̈nihan isxan̈ab naj.

Naj chul tuꞌ lahan naj hacaꞌ hunu naj chixunilo iskꞌal ixim trigo, nan chakꞌ naj ixim sat, nan chakꞌpaxo naj ixim yoj, wal ixim sat tuꞌ chiscꞌubato naj ixim yul iscꞌun̈a, haxa ixim yoj tuꞌ xin chiskꞌojto naj ixim xol kꞌa kꞌaꞌ mach istan̈bal,” ẍi naj Juan tuꞌ.
Yet yah haꞌ iswiꞌ Comam Jesús
Yet huneꞌ tiempohal tuꞌ el Comam Jesús bey Galilea, isto Comam istiꞌ haꞌ niman Jordán iscꞌatan̈ naj Juan, yu yah haꞌ iswiꞌ Comam yu naj.

Wal naj Juan tuꞌ mach chisje naj yakꞌaꞌcan̈ haꞌ iswiꞌ Comam. Yalni naj tet Comam: —Machoj, wal xin haꞌ hawet hach yilal hawanican̈ haꞌ inwiꞌan, maẍtajach chachhul incꞌatan̈an yu wanican̈an haꞌ hawiꞌ, ẍi naj.
Yajaꞌ takꞌwi Comam tet naj: —Mach chu haman̈cꞌon huneꞌ tiꞌ, wal xin yilal coyijen tzet chal Comam Dios, ẍi Comam. Hac tuꞌ xin yu isyijen naj Juan yanican̈ haꞌ iswiꞌ Comam Jesús.
Yet lahwi yah haꞌ iswiꞌ Comam tuꞌ, yahti Comam xol haꞌ, yin̈n̈ena tuꞌ ishajni isba satcan̈. Yilni Comam yayilo Comam Espíritu Santo yiban̈ hacaꞌ hunu noꞌ cuwis.
Yabelax huneꞌ yul nukꞌe satcan̈, halni hacaꞌ tiꞌ: —Haꞌ naj tiꞌ Incꞌaholan, caw xahan ay wuhan, caw chintzalahan yin̈ naj, ẍiaytij.

footnotes.text: Ebnaj fariseo haꞌ ton huntekꞌan ebnaj Israel chiyijen hun majan ley akꞌbilcano tet naj Moisés yu Comam Dios. Chiscuy ebnaj anma Israel yin̈ huntekꞌan chejbanile tuꞌ, yajaꞌ ay huntekꞌanxa chejbanile akꞌbilcano yu ebnaj, haꞌ xin ayco yin̈ isnabal ebnaj isyijeni, caw tzeꞌ ebnaj yin̈. Tit ishowal ebnaj yin̈ Comam Jesucristo yu yal Comam ta mach cꞌul isbeybal ebnaj.
